- **Everything else in activity came back empty:** active energy burned, active minutes, active zone minutes, activity level, altitude, basal energy burned, calories in heart rate zone, distance, floors, sedentary period, swim lengths, time in heart rate zone, and total calories. - No intraday data was requested, so this covers daily totals only.
- No other categories (sleep, heart, body, and so on) were included in this job.
